title: NIA opens 6 solar-powered irrigation sites in Leyte amid El Niño

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — The National Irrigation Administration (NIA) in Eastern Visayas has inaugurated six solar-powered irrigation facilities in Leyte to strengthen water supply to farmlands and help farmers prepare for the possible effects of the looming Super El Niño. NIA Region 8, led by Regional Manager Jaime de Jesus, formally opened the Opong Solar Pump Irrigation Project (SPIP) in Barangay Opong, Tolosa, Leyte, and five sites of the Mainit Solar Pump Irrigation Project under the Mainit River Irrigation System on Oct. 28. The six solar-powered facilities are designed to augment water supplies in existing irrigation systems, particularly in downstream and tail-end […]...
